Such a refreshing experience after going to many other local dispensaries in the area. It was easily the best experience I’ve had at a local SJ dispensary. I will definitely be coming back more regularly.

Everyone is so sweet and helpful. Always very patient and accommodating. No one is there to just sell you stuff they really care about your well-being and finding the most effective method to address your issues. It’s all very interesting and educational. A fine upstanding establishment and always an enjoyable experience.

I stumbled upon Highway 90 Dispensary in Marlton, New Jersey on a recent trip to the Mt Laurel area. The staff welcomed me with a smile and were very pleasant thru out my visit. I’m familiar with most of the brands they carry but the few I wasn’t, they took the time to answer the questions I had about them. They gave me 15% off as a first time customer, which I was very grateful for. All in all it was a great experience and I intend of returning in the near future!

I love this dispensary! Definitely in my top 3! The prices are great here! Not only that they have a great selection of products to choose from. Personally, I look for HIGH THC products. I don’t like going below 30% THC and those kinda of products are available unlike other places. I was greeted by Cathy and she was absolutely wonderful. Very friendly and has this positive energy. She educated me very well on Live Rosin extracts which is very appreciated! Oh! And I got this really cute dog tote! 🙂

Now that we have an influx of dispensaries in our area, I still go nowhere else but highway 90. They are always so friendly and always so well run and have the best specials. They are the best around don’t go anywhere else
I had a cool, smooth experience here! Good product selection and knowledge of bud in general. Kathy was a great help I appreciate how she made the transactions smooth and with ease.

Absolutely love highway 90! All of the staff is friendly and so helpful. I stop in very often and am never disappointed. Shoutout kathy for helping me with my latest purchase! Will keep coming back always ❤️

Love it here!!!!! After trying so many different dispensaries, this one is still hands-down my favorite. The staff is always so pleasant, genuinely helpful, and just all-around cool people! highly recommend 😊

Pre- order, pick up. My order was ready when I arrived .Dylan answered some questions I had about a different product, then I usually order. He was knowledgeable, had a good vibe, and asked for my feedback,( the next time I came in)on the new purchase I made.
Never had a bad experience at Highway 90. They Also always have what I am looking for.
Thanks to the great team at Highway 90.

I had a great experience at Highway 90! Especially because of their customer service! The customer service was amazing and super friendly and helpful! The cashiers names were Reid, Nat, and Sofe. They were all extremely friendly and helpful people and I’m just so grateful to Highway 90 for such an awesome experience buying weed!!!

Marianne, Kathy, and Mia were so helpful! The deals here were great, and the recommendations were fantastic. I’m an old school stoner, so most dispensaries bum me out. Not here. The team really creates a welcoming vibe and an understanding of the product. I was really thankful for the help and kindness ❤️
